d42: That night, they bring Tiana home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
d44: You say a few words for Tiana. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d44: You bury Tiana. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+4 trauma)

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tiana Shevchenko is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Tiana is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.
d41: 🕯️ Tiana Shevchenko is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Tiana kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Tiana's gone." Tyler looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tiana." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Kate blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Swimmer (Level 1). Cross water freely. Rivers are roads to you.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tiana Shevchenko, 41 days. The mantle passes to Kate Konate.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Kate Konate, 31 — a Sailor. Her hands know different work now: Bloodhound, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room, Bird Whisperer.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Tiana — and Tiana is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Tyler, Cem, Elena and 1 more speak for Kate — "Tiana trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Kate before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
